item_name: Rothco Woodland Camo 2 QT Desert Canteen
item_short_desc: Rothco’s Woodland Camo 2 QT Desert Canteen is an essential item for your outdoor adventures. Constructed with a sturdy plastic/polyethylene inner body and a tinplate outer body, this canteen ensures durability and longevity. The outer cover, made from soft terylene and acrylic material, adds a touch of comfort and style to your gear. This BPA-free canteen is safe for use, making it an ideal choice for campers, hikers, and outdoor enthusiasts. The screw-on cap is securely attached to the bottle to prevent any leaks.
